title: docs: state mimid's answers to identity-arch §6 interop questions
description: From assay .44.51 (draft-barnes-mimi-identity-arch-04 §6, L681ff). Add to mimid's README/Limitations a short section: E2E protocol MLS (RFC 9420); credentials are BasicCredential carrying the mimi user URI; no revocation; the authority vouching for a leaf is implicitly its provider (domain of the URI), so mimid gives no E2E protection against impersonation by a provider (identity-arch L260-268). Link mimi-protocol#159 and decisions .44.4/.44.27 (track only).
